stories.title: Trump announces deal for Russian diesel as Zelensky criticises 'gift to Putin'
stories.body: Ukraine's president said allowing Russia to sell petroleum products would prolong a war that must be ended.

stories.title: US unveils sanctions on ICC in move court condemns as 'assault on rule of law'
stories.body: Several member states of the international tribunal, including the UK, say they "strongly disagree" with the sanctions.

stories.title: JD Vance casts doubt on firing squad execution and says he will not watch it
stories.body: The planned execution of Nidal Hasan by firing squad would be the first military execution in more than 60 years.

stories.title: Powerful magnitude 7.7 earthquake hits Panama, damaging buildings
stories.body: Tsunami warnings are issued for neighbouring countries as videos of destruction circulate online.

stories.title: Russian search engine Yandex struggles after Ukrainian strikes on data centres
stories.body: Often dubbed "Russia's Google", the tech firm admits customers may experience disruption to digital services due to the attacks.

stories.title: Man named Hitler Mussolini elected mayor in Peru
stories.body: The left-wing candidate won a narrow victory in a remote district in the Peruvian Andes, exit polls show.

stories.title: Navi Pillay, former UN human rights chief, wins Nobel Peace Prize
stories.body: Pillay is recognised for her "efforts to promote peace and international law", the Norwegian Nobel Committee says.

stories.title: Three men found guilty of murdering two Australian surfer brothers and US friend
stories.body: The bodies of Jake and Callum Robinson and their friend Carter Rhoad were found at the bottom of a well.

stories.title: Ethiopia warns Eritrea it will defend itself after troops cross border
stories.body: Truckloads of Eritrean soldiers have been seen driving into Ethiopia, which has reportedly responded with drone strikes.

stories.title: Commentator Katie Zacharia picked as new White House press secretary
stories.body: The conservative commentator currently works as a communications adviser at Trump Media & Technology Group.

stories.title: Thieves steal 30,000 bottles of wine worth €5m in Italy, reports say
stories.body: The heist at the Florence-based winery is believed to be one of the largest thefts of its kind in Italy.

stories.title: US immigration officials defend ICE agents who shot man in same car as child
stories.body: Oscar Belgal, the 28-year-old man, survived the shooting and is now being held at a detention facility outside of New York, officials said.

stories.title: France promises 3,000 extra teachers in first step to calm student protests
stories.body: Education minister Edouard Geffray makes the offer after another day of sometimes violent demonstrations by high-school students.

stories.title: Three Saudi nationals killed in Houthi attacks on Riyadh airport
stories.body: The missile attacks come amid an escalation in fighting between the Iran-backed group and Saudi Arabia, which backs Yemen's government.

stories.title: Suspect linked to Monaco bomb attack on millionaire speaks to BBC
stories.body: Vitalii Zhykovych gives his own account of the attempted assassination of Ukrainian-born businessman Vadym Yermolayev.

stories.title: Crazy Rich Asians to return as TV show with original film's stars
stories.body: It will pick up after the hit 2018 film, starring Constance Wu, Henry Golding, Michelle Yeoh and Ronny Chieng.

stories.title: Doctor accused of 1994 Rwanda genocide offences to face trial in UK
stories.body: Dr Vincent Brown was allegedly a "leader" or "supervisor" of violent acts carried out by others in the early days of the genocide.

stories.title: Two Renoir paintings stolen from French museum are recovered
stories.body: The two works were seized last month when thieves cut through a fence and smashed a window at the Renoir Museum on the French Riviera.

stories.title: Cars torched and shops looted as anti-migrant violence erupts in South Africa
stories.body: South Africa has experienced recurrent outbreaks of violence, often targeting migrants from neighbouring countries.

stories.title: Christa Pike has 'profound' health turnaround after botched execution, lawyers say
stories.body: Pike's lawyers say her recovery is "remarkable" as they give an update on her condition after she survived an execution attempt by lethal injection.

The alignment of top signals with governance and stability clusters indicates a potential for incremental progress, but this is counterbalanced by the disruptive potential of natural disasters and geopolitical tensions.
